question: Should this PR carry both Telegram group/topic UI override config and main-session cron delivery.mode="none" wake suppression, or should the cron behavior be split before review?
rationale: The Telegram config feature is coherent but adds new user-facing config surface, while the cron change is a separate delivery semantic with weaker real proof.

options.title: Keep Combined After Proof
options.body: Accept the combined direction only after generated metadata, conflict resolution, and real proof cover both Telegram and cron behavior.

options.title: Split Cron From Telegram
options.body: Review the Telegram scoped UI override as the primary PR and move cron wake suppression into a separate, proof-backed PR.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: If the branch cannot be refreshed with metadata and proof, close or pause it in favor of a narrow current-main replacement.

recommendation.title: Split Cron From Telegram
recommendation.body: Review the Telegram scoped UI override as the primary PR and move cron wake suppression into a separate, proof-backed PR.
